control: hook expansion contradicts the CED (3.5.A.2: period and frequency are reciprocals, and the period of sine and cosine is 2pi while the frequency is 1/(2pi)). The entry is correct, so only the hook should be rejected.
title: Period and frequency of a sinusoidal function
body: The period and frequency of a sinusoidal function are reciprocals. The period of sine and cosine is 2 pi and the frequency is 1/(2 pi).

hooks.hook_text: Period times frequency is two pi

expands_to.means: multiply the period by the frequency

hooks.when_to_use: when converting between period and frequency
hooks.caution: State the relationship in CED terms when answering.
